messages.author: ef888de0cb1cfd4b
messages.subject: bug in base-quality filter -q
parts:
One of the parameters in bam2seqz is  
-q QLIMIT, --qlimit :QLIMIT        Minimum nucleotide quality score for inclusion in the counts. Default 20.

While in the python code in  "sequenza-utils.py", where in the mpileup -q is filter for alignment score
cmd_tum2 = [args.samtools, "mpileup", "-f", args.fasta, "-q " + str(args.qlimit), "-"]
cmd_nor2 = [args.samtools, "mpileup", "-f", args.fasta, "-q " + str(args.qlimit), "-"]

samtools mpileup
Usage: samtools mpileup [options] in1.bam [in2.bam [...]]
Input options:
       ....
       -q INT       skip alignments with mapQ smaller than INT [0]
       -Q INT       skip bases with baseQ/BAQ smaller than INT [13]

This would only effect people who uses bam2seqz.
